findings.summary: The 'مسار الاعتماد' heading is a bespoke Text with copyWith styling instead of reusing the shared MobileSectionHeader widget.
findings.fix: Replace the raw Text (lines 104-109) with const MobileSectionHeader(title: 'مسار الاعتماد') so section headers render consistently across pages.

findings.summary: The _ErrorState is a plain centered text plus button with no error/brand icon, inconsistent with a polished error presentation.
findings.fix: Add an Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error) above the message (with spacing) so the error state has a clear visual anchor consistent with other states.

findings.summary: The empty approval-steps state (lines 111-117) is a bespoke plain-text Card with no icon or muted styling, unlike a polished empty state.
findings.fix: Style the empty message with colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant and add a small leading icon (e.g. Icons.route_outlined) to match empty-state treatment used elsewhere.

findings.summary: The step CircleAvatar uses default theme colors while the step's status color is ignored, so the order badge gives no status cue.
findings.fix: Tint the CircleAvatar background/foreground per step.status using the shared status color mapping, or set scheme.primaryContainer/onPrimaryContainer explicitly for intent clarity.

findings.summary: Inter-card vertical spacing is inconsistent: 12 between top cards (lines 97,103) but 16 for action buttons (lines 121,132) and 8 for the section header (line 110).
findings.fix: Standardize the vertical gaps between stacked cards/sections to a single spacing token (e.g. 12) so the detail list has consistent rhythm.

findings.summary: The cancel/decide dialog confirm buttons silently no-op when the reason is too short (lines 177, 232), giving the user no feedback about why nothing happened.
findings.fix: Show an inline helperText/error on the TextField when the minimum length is not met instead of an unexplained non-response on confirm.
